body.statement: For constants depending only on \(\epsilon\), \(R_{n,d,\epsilon}\ge c_\epsilon\min\{1,d/[n\log(ed)]\}\) for every \(n\ge1\) and \(d\ge2\), by a same-class reduction in which \(\int|t|\,dG_P(t)\) equals the normalized \(\ell_1\) separation of two categorical mass vectors.
body.justification: This floor carries the rare-cell unknown-mass obstruction into the law target without assuming a stand-in CATE functional.
body.gap: The in-repository scalar theorem supplies the normalized \(\ell_1\) hard family; the new work must prove that its actual causal subexperiment pushes forward to \(G_P\) with the displayed identity.
body.consumer: It supplies a necessary consistency condition for every probability-valued CATE-law estimator.
